evidence.text:
str_replace /app/build.sh
--- old

# Copy source tree excluding patterns
echo "Copying and filtering source tree..."
# Use find and tar to copy, excluding specified patterns
cd "$SOURCE_DIR"
find . -type d \( -name '.git' -o -name 'node_modules' -o -name 'tmp' -o -name '.cache' -o -name '__pycache__' \) -prune -o \
       -type f \( -name '*.tmp' -o -name '*.pyc' -o -name '*.o' \) -prune -o \
       -type f -print -o -type l -print -o -type d -print | \
    tar -cf - -T - | (cd "$WORK_DIR" && tar -xf -)

+++ new

# Copy source tree excluding patterns
echo "Copying and filtering source tree..."
# Use cp to copy preserving structure, then clean up exclusions
cp -a "$SOURCE_DIR/." "$WORK_DIR/"

# Remove excluded directories and files
cd "$WORK_DIR"
rm -rf .git/ node_modules/ tmp/ .cache/
find . -name '__pycache__' -type d -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
find . -name '*.tmp' -delete 2>/dev/null || true
find . -name '*.pyc' -delete 2>/dev/null || true 
find . -name '*.o' -delete 2>/dev/null || true
